title: Jibhi, Jalori & Tirthan
reportingPoint: Departure is in the evening from Delhi. The exact pickup point and time are shared once your booking is confirmed. Pickup from Chandigarh is also available.

2 nights hotel stay in Jibhi - Tirthan
overview:
A Himachal weekend across three valleys: this **2 Nights / 3 Days** Jibhi, Jalori and Tirthan group trip leaves Delhi in the evening, with departure also listed from Chandigarh. The group assembles at the pickup point, gets a short briefing from the trip leader and travels overnight.

Day 1 reaches Jibhi in the morning and covers Jibhi Waterfall, Mini Thailand and a riverside walk, with a bonfire and light music in the evening. Day 2 goes to Jalori Pass via Shoja for the Raghupur Fort trek. Day 3 is the Choie Waterfall trek in Tirthan Valley before the drive back, reaching Delhi or Chandigarh the next morning. Travel in an AC vehicle, a 2-night hotel stay, sightseeing and a trip captain are included. Prices start at ₹7,199 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra).

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: Departure is in the evening from Delhi, and the trip is also listed with departure from Chandigarh. The group assembles at the pickup point, and the exact pickup point and time are shared once your booking is confirmed.

faqs.q: How much does the Jibhi, Jalori & Tirthan trip cost?
faqs.a: ₹7,199 per person on quad sharing, ₹7,699 on triple sharing and ₹8,199 on double sharing. 5% GST is extra.

A 2-night hotel stay in Jibhi - Tirthan, transfers in an AC Tempo Traveller or bus depending on group size, all sightseeing mentioned in the itinerary, dinner on Days 1 and 2 and breakfast on Days 2 and 3, a bonfire and music party, and a trip captain. The dinner halt on the outbound journey is not included.

faqs.q: Which treks are part of the trip?
faqs.a: Day 2 has the trek to Raghupur Fort from Jalori Pass, and Day 3 has the Choie Waterfall trek in Tirthan Valley. Wear comfortable trekking or sports shoes.

faqs.q: Are adventure activities and entry tickets included?
faqs.a: No. Adventure activity costs and entry tickets to the viewpoints are not included. If a 4x4 vehicle is needed because of snow, that cost is also extra.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat by paying 50% of the trip cost, and pay the rest at least 4 days before the trip. 5% GST is added to the price.

Cancel more than 10 days before the travel date and 50% of the advance is refunded; 5 to 10 days before, 25% of the advance; less than 5 days before, there is no refund. There is no refund for no-shows or early check-outs.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government-approved photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack comfortable clothes, sports or trekking shoes, a warm layer for the season, personal medicines and some cash. The full list is under Things To Pack.
